verses.1: And as a result of all this, all of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah came out. They destroyed all the idols and temples that existed among them. From Benjamin, Ephraim, Manasseh, all the way to all other places, all of Israel returned to their own cities.
verses.2: And Jehizkiah stood at the entrances of the priests’ and Levites’ quarters, one by one. He supervised each person’s work as it related to their duties with regard to the priests, the Levites, and those who served God. He also supervised the worshipers and those who praised God in the doors of the LORD’s houses.
verses.3: And the king gave from his wealth for the needs of the women who went up on the days of worship, as well as for their expenses during the holidays, and for other purposes as written in the laws of Jehovah.
verses.4: And he said to the people of Jerusalem, “Give food to the priests and the Levites, so that they may be strengthened by the word of the LORD.”
verses.5: And as a result of this, the children of Israel began to plant crops such as wheat, barley, vegetables, and all kinds of fruits from the fields. They also began to cultivate all kinds of crops.
verses.6: And the children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought offerings of grain, sheep, and other sacred offerings that were dedicated to their God, Jehovah. They presented these offerings as sacrifices.
verses.7: In the third month, the trials began. And in the seventh month, everything ended.
verses.8: And Jehizkiah and the priests came and saw the miracles that had taken place. They blessed Jehovah and his people, Israel.
verses.9: And Jehizkiah taught about the priests and the Levites regarding their duties.
verses.10: And Azariah, the chief priest of the temple of Zadok, said to him, “From now on, bring offerings to the Temple of Jehovah, both sacrifices and offerings. Do this until the end, for Jehovah has blessed his people, and he has removed this evil from them.”
verses.11: And Jehizkiah said, “Prepare the rooms in the house of Jehovah.” And they prepared them.
verses.12: And they brought the offerings, the sacrifices, and the sacred items with sincerity. And upon them, they said, “Kananiyahu Haliwai, and Shimei Akihiyahu Mishne.”
verses.13: And Yechiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Yerimot, Yozebad, Eliel, and Ismakiyahu; also Machat and Benyahu. They were appointed by Kananiyahu. And Shimi, his brother, was in charge of the king’s affairs. Azariyahu was the judge in the court of God.
verses.14: And Koré ben-Yimna, the Levite from the east, offered sacrifices to God for His gifts. He wanted to please Jehovah and the holy ones.
verses.15: And by his hand, Eiden, Minyan, Yeshua, and Shemaiah said, “Let us go into the towns of the priests, in truth, so that we may give them gifts in small amounts.”
verses.16: In addition, they were set aside as reminders from the age of six years old onward. They are also kept in the house of Jehovah, for use on the day of their service, in accordance with their duties as part of their responsibilities.
verses.17: And the priests returned to their homes. The Levites also returned from a period of forty years, and they were able to return to their homes in their respective regions.
verses.18: And their wives, sons, and daughters shall be sanctified for every congregation, because in their truth they will become holy.
verses.19: And the priests of Aaron went into the fields of Migdol, in every city and village. They were men who were chosen by their names to give offerings to all the priests and to all those who were worthy of worship.
verses.20: And Jehizkiah did just that throughout all of Judah. He carried out what was good and righteous, and true, before the LORD, his God.
verses.21: And in every act that began with the work of the Temple of God, and with the Torah and commandments, he succeeded.
